A detailed understanding of how mTOR metabolically coordinates effector responses by myeloid cells will provide important insights into immunity in health and disease. Rapamycin, the prototypical inhibitor of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR), was discovered in soil samples from Easter Island (locally known as Rapa Nui) in the 1970s, and found to have antifungal activity.
